sentences.en: I need to free up some storage space on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我需要在我的手机上释放一些存储空间。

sentences.en: We have plenty of storage space in the attic, perfect for old clothes.
sentences.zh: 阁楼上有很多存储空间，正好放旧衣服。

sentences.en: The company offers cloud storage space for all its employees to use.
sentences.zh: 公司为所有员工提供云存储空间使用。
